name: maclaw-cli
description: Zero-config local CLI for agents to control MaClaw GUI through the third-party IM gateway.

state.key: clientId + sessionId; conversationId only overrides the protocol id when sessionId is also set

remoteAccess.purpose: Configure and verify remote MaClawSrv third-party gateway access for the authenticated user.

commands.setup: Enable access. Generates and prints a gateway token only when no token exists or --gateway-token is supplied.
commands.info: Print existing integration credentials intentionally for handoff to a third-party client.
commands.show: Inspect current remote access status without printing the token by default.
commands.token: Rotate gateway token and print the new value once.
commands.disable: Disable third-party gateway access for the authenticated user.
commands.test: Handshake against <srv>/api/im-gateway/v1 using the gateway token.

tokens.userApiToken: Second positional for setup/info/show/token/disable. Authenticates to MaClawSrv and selects the user.
tokens.gatewayToken: Second positional for test, or MACLAWSRV_GATEWAY_TOKEN for test only. Bearer token used by third-party protocol clients.

remoteAccess.urlRules: --srv and --endpoint must be absolute http:// or https:// URLs without query strings or fragments.

output.token: Present only when a new token is generated, explicitly set, rotated, or info/include-token intentionally reveals an existing token.
output.tokenPresent: Boolean; true when a gateway token exists even if token is redacted.
output.next: Human-readable next command. Prefer clientUse.testArgv or clientUse.env in automation.
output.clientUse.baseUrl: Gateway protocol base URL for third-party clients.
output.clientUse.token: Gateway bearer token when intentionally revealed; otherwise <token>.
output.clientUse.testArgv: Array argv for testing gateway access without shell parsing.
output.clientUse.env: Environment map for testing with maclaw-cli srv test and for passing credentials to another client.

remoteAccess.normalMode: No tenant id or user id is required; the user API token identifies the MaClawSrv user.
remoteAccess.adminFallback: Use --admin-token --tenant --user only when an owner configures another user.
